task: Go to https://www.uclahealth.org/cms-hpt.txt and read it. Then open the source-page-url it lists. On that page, find every link to a machine-readable standard charges file and any link to the hospital's financial assistance or charity care policy. Do not download large files. Return the URLs exactly as written on the page, any 'last updated' text shown, and short notes on what the page says about the file.

output.notes: The page labels the four JSON downloads by hospital and says the file contains information complying with CMS machine-readable-file pricing transparency requirements. The page has a “Help Paying Your Bill” link to UCLA Health’s hospital financial-assistance information, which describes eligibility and provides Financial Assistance Policy documents. No “last updated” text was shown. No large files were downloaded.
